title: Which Egg Hides the Dragon?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg Hides the Dragon? Can YOU Guess? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Three mysterious eggs — but only ONE has a dragon inside! Can you guess which one before the reveal? 🐉🔥 Watch every day for a new guessing challenge!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dragon #Eggs #KidsYouTube #Kidify #FunForKids #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these eggs is hiding a DRAGON — but which one?
You've got three choices — the red egg, the blue egg, or the golden egg!
Pick your egg and get ready — the countdown is starting!
The red egg cracks open and — it's just a rubber chicken! Nope, no dragon here!
The blue egg opens and — oh wow, it's a tiny frog! Cute, but not a dragon!
The GOLDEN egg cracks… and there it is — a baby dragon! The golden egg wins!
Did you get it right? Level two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
